summary: Independent review of Jin Shu 86 owned units s0211–s0420 (skipping unowned s0254/s0313) against the Chinese text only. Conventional reign-year labels used where the source writes them (建興四年 / 太興三年 / 是歲建興六年 / 二年 after 建興初) convert as 建興 313–316, 太興 318–321, 永昌 322–323, 太寧 323–326, 咸和 326–334; year-only labels are not treated as Gregorian month/day dates, and there is no year 0. Surviving supported chronology includes the Shanggui/Jianxing-6 cluster windows, Zhang Shi’s Taixing 3 murder, Zhang Mao’s 314 summons and 320 accession with unresolved Taining death, Zhang Jun’s 316 enfeoffment and 18 sui, honest unresolved Taining/Fuhan/heir rows, 咸和初 sequels kept as onOrAfter 326, and retrospective citations kept off life dates. Defects are concentrated in four over-precise conversions (建興初→313, 歲餘→Taixing 4, 明年→Yongchang 1, 咸和初→326–327), Yuan Di’s death day imported from 崩問, Min’s death year used as an active hint, an unflagged 太寧元年 reception on the 少帝 citation, two “before Yongchang 1” hints that exclude 322, and Zhang Jun’s omitted 十歲 age. Competing Jin Shu / Tongjian Taining witnesses are preserved where the extraction already marked them unresolved.
